title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
author: Jane Doe
description: A rich and creamy tomato pasta that's ready in 30 minutes.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
In a large skillet, sauté minced garlic until fragrant. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce. Add reserved pasta water as needed to reach desired consistency.
tips: For a bit of heat, add 1/2 tsp of red pepper flakes with the garlic.
